create_albert_config_default: create an ALBERT model configuration with default xxlarge settings
create_albert_config_custom: create an ALBERT-base configuration with custom hidden_size, num_attention_heads, and intermediate_size
init_albert_model_from_config: initialize an ALBERT model with random weights from a given configuration
access_model_config: access the configuration object from an initialized ALBERT model instance
configure_albert_embedding: configure ALBERT embedding size, vocab size, and position embeddings
